claims.claim: Schrodinger's platform sits between computational drug-design technology and pharma R&D demand; the BMS Bunsen deployment is evidence of workflow integration, while the Tectora structure creates a second path from internal discovery assets to externally financed development.

The causal thesis depends on computational/agentic tools producing enough useful research acceleration or asset quality to earn durable software use or downstream economics; partner announcements alone do not establish that conversion.

factors.name: bottleneckControl
factors.basis: Workflow integration can increase influence over computational discovery, but pharma customers retain alternative software, internal tools and experimental validation paths.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Software plus asset-monetization creates two economic paths, while both remain dependent on partner conversion and scientific outcomes.

factors.name: substitutionResilience
factors.basis: Embedded workflows and proprietary physics/ML can create switching friction, but competing AI/drug-design stacks and internal pharma capabilities remain substitutes.

causalEdges.mechanism: software-assisted hypothesis generation and molecular design
embedded use can support recurring or expanded commercial relationships
partners fund development while Schrodinger retains equity and contingent economics

risks.risk: Successor bottleneck shifts from computational design to experimental validation, clinical development and partner commercialization.

unknowns.unknown: Magnitude and durability of Bunsen economics and measurable research productivity uplift are undisclosed in cited evidence.

claims.claim: Current partner validation is real but does not prove durable revenue scale, superior drug outcomes or attractive probability-adjusted asset economics.

factors.name: confidence inflation
factors.basis: Named pharma adoption can be overread as proof of economics or scientific superiority when disclosed evidence establishes deployment, not magnitude of value capture.

factors.name: source dependence
factors.basis: Current Beta lineage is company-primary; the named counterparties and financing structure are concrete, but independent outcome evidence remains limited.

risks.risk: Competing AI discovery platforms and internal pharma capabilities can limit pricing power or differentiation.
Tectora transfers development burden but also leaves value realization contingent on externally controlled execution and scientific success.

unknowns.unknown: No independent evidence in current lineage quantifies Bunsen productivity advantage, renewal behavior or downstream clinical hit-rate improvement.
